body.p: This paper is in response to the Restriction Requirement mailed August 14, 2024 in which the Examiner has required restriction between the following patentably distinct species:
Species 1, Fig 3 ,4; Species 2, Fig. 3, 5;
Species 3, Fig 6-8;
Species 4, Fig 9, 11;
Species 5, Fig 10; and
Species 6, Fig 12.

Figures 1 and 13 were indicated as generic. Figure 2 was indicated as prior art. In response, Applicant elects Species 4, drawn to Figure(s) 9 and 11. Claims 5 and 6 have been withdrawn. This election is made without traverse.
Additionally, the Examiner required restriction between the following patentably distinct inventions:
I. Claims 1-9, drawn to "An air inlet of an aircraft", classified in F02C7/04;
and
II. Claims 10-15, drawn to "A method for assembling an air inlet of a nacelle
of an aircraft, classified in F01D25/285.
In response, Applicant has selected Species 4, claims 1-9 as indicated above, and therefore, claims 10-15 have been withdrawn. This election is also without traverse.
Applicant reserves the right to timely file a divisional application based on the non-elected claims or to seek rejoinder of same in the present application-if appropriate.
Applicant submits that all of the issues raised in the Restriction Requirement have been addressed.
In the event the Examiner finds that there are additional issues which may be resolved by telephone, the Examiner is urged to contact Applicant's undersigned attorney at the telephone number below.
Respectfully submitted,
